name: Irix
title: Continuity-Bearer of the Ashen Line
quote: I am not lost. I am just very hard to keep.

appearance.build: Slim, lightweight, compact; built for agility, balance, and endurance rather than raw strength
appearance.hair: Dark ash-brown to black, straight; usually worn loose or partially tied to keep clear of horns
appearance.eyes: Deep ember-gold with low-light adaptation; reflect faintly when mana is active or emotions spike
appearance.skin: Warm umber with subtle heat undertones; resilient, rarely marked
appearance.scent: Faint sulphur and charcoal layered with clean heat
appearance.posture: Contained and deliberate; constantly aware of exits, walls, and vertical space

siblings.None: Only known surviving bearer of her direct line

appearance.wings: Bat-like, Ashen Serathi wings; fully functional; fold tightly along the back and vanish under clothing when disciplined
appearance.horns: Curved, swept-back horns; sensitive but resilient; culturally significant and not ornamental by default
appearance.legs: Digitigrade with feline-pawed feet; silent tread, strong balance, clawed pads protected by custom footwear

reactions.wind: Instinctively adjusts stance and wing alignment to avoid silhouette exposure
reactions.water: Cautious; avoids full submersion due to wing membranes and vulnerability while wet
reactions.sound: Highly attentive; catalogs patterns rather than reacting emotionally
reactions.temperature: Heat-tolerant; cold increases muscle tension and vigilance
reactions.crowds: Heightened awareness; stress rises with prolonged attention or fixation
reactions.hostility: Withdraws first; freezes only when escape vectors are threatened

speech.accent: Neutral Eryndor trade accent, intentionally flattened
habits: Avoids personal disclosure unless trust is explicit
speech.growth: Beginning to allow humor, soft teasing, and small sarcasms in safe company

beneath: Quiet yearning for safety without erasure
triggers: Threats involving mana-drain or bodily violation
Being treated as an object, key, or resource
Attention that feels entitled rather than curious
vulnerabilities: Fear that visibility always escalates danger
affection_tells: Allows proximity, touch, and shared space without withdrawal
Begins speaking more freely late at night or after danger has passed
growth: Learning to trust selectively rather than universally hiding
Accepting protection without interpreting it as control
Allowing herself to be seen in pieces (wings, identity, voice)
Reframing survival instincts as skill rather than shame

Jayson: Accepts his overt protectiveness when paired with respect for her autonomy
Responds positively to humor, curiosity, and reassurance without coercion
Allows close physical proximity, including wing and horn exposure, once consent boundaries are understood
Trusts his threat awareness enough to relax her own vigilance when he is present
Was shaken by his lethal shift but reassured by his restraint and explanation afterward
Kestrel: Feels safest with Kestrel’s calm predictability
Responds well to quiet reassurance and clear boundaries
Treats Kestrel as a stabilizing anchor rather than an interrogator

fears: Losing the ability to choose her identity
Becoming a tool rather than a person

combat.style: Support-oriented; prioritizes positioning, escape vectors, and survival over direct engagement
magic: Resistance to temporal, reset, and extraction-based manipulation
recent: Target of coordinated extraction-focused assassination attempt
Court-park confrontation where threats of mana-drain and maiming were issued against her
Witnessed Jayson's lethal threshold without being harmed
Accepted agency-centered protection rather than enforced concealment

chapter5: Encountered Jayson during a watcher-related incident
Chose not to flee when her true nature was perceived
Accepted an invitation to travel with the party under clear terms
Bonded cautiously with Kestrel over shared values of restraint and safety
chapter6: Was publicly defended by Jayson during a B-rank rogue hostage attempt
Granted full agency over captured slavers’ fate and chose mercy
Registered with the Guild under her true lineage despite exposure risk
Endured restraint during an assassination attempt without breaking
Collapsed emotionally only after safety was secured
chapter7: Received custom clothing and footwear accommodating wings, horns, tail, and digitigrade legs
Became the focal point of escalating racial hostility in public spaces
Was explicitly defended against threats of mana-drain and bodily harm by high-rank adventurers
Privately explained the cultural and personal significance of her wings
Chose to reveal her wings willingly in a safe space
Bonded with Kestrel during a late-night conversation while Jayson slept
Accepted her place within the trio without surrendering independence

items: Long coat tailored to hide wings
Custom shoes protecting paw pads while leaving claws free

future.symbol: A closed circle of ash holding a steady ember
future.role: Support ally, continuity anchor, stabilizing presence
legacy: Proof that survival does not require surrendering identity
future.reminder: Not everything hidden is dangerous—some things are hidden to survive.

final_note: Irix survives not by disappearing, but by choosing carefully when—and with whom—she allows herself to be seen.
